assets.prompt: Understated retro 1980s synthwave background score, like the quiet opening of an action movie trailer. Warm analog synth pads and a soft, steady pulsing synth bass arpeggio, light muted drum machine, gentle and hypnotic. Meanders calmly at a constant low energy, slowly evolving textures, no big drops, no crescendo. Soft mellow tone, rolled-off highs, no piercing leads, no harsh repetitive stabs, no distortion. Spacious, quiet, relaxed dynamic mix with plenty of headroom. Instrumental, no vocals.
assets.lyrics:
[Intro — warm synth pad swells in softly]
[Verse — soft pulsing bass arpeggio, muted drum machine, calm]
[Verse — the same groove continues, a gentle pad melody drifts in]
[Verse — steady and understated, textures slowly evolve]
[Outro — the pulse fades, pad holds a soft chord]
